BALATRO-LOW_STAKES.title: Low Stakes
BALATRO-LOW_STAKES.description: At the start of each combat, discard any number of cards then draw that many.
BALATRO-HEADS_UP.title: Heads Up
BALATRO-HEADS_UP.description: Gain [E] at the start of your turn.
BALATRO-NEST_EGG.title: Nest Egg
BALATRO-NEST_EGG.flavor: Some extra cash for on the way.
BALATRO-NEST_EGG.description: Gain #b300 #yGold at the start of the run.
BALATRO-YOU_GET_WHAT_YOU_GET.title: You Get What You Get
BALATRO-YOU_GET_WHAT_YOU_GET.description: At the end of the turn gain #b2 #yGold for each card in hand. Gain no #yGold in combat rewards.
BALATRO-ROYALE.title: Royale
BALATRO-ROYALE.flavor: Is this the reward you are looking for?
BALATRO-ROYALE.description: On Card Reward screens you have #b2 additional cards to choose from. Lose [E] at the start of your turn.
BALATRO-CRYSTAL_BALL.title: Crystal Ball
BALATRO-CRYSTAL_BALL.flavor: Everybody needs a little bit of magic.
BALATRO-ASTRONOMY.title: Astronomy
BALATRO-ASTRONOMY.flavor: You'll end up grading everything with stickers.
BALATRO-ASTRONOMY.description: After you play a card, #yUpgrade it for this combat. Lose a #yPotion slot.
BALATRO-CLAIRVOYANCE.title: Clairvoyance
BALATRO-CLAIRVOYANCE.flavor: Don't turn as gray as a ghost.
BALATRO-CLAIRVOYANCE.description: Combat rewards can now contain #yColorless cards. Choose a #yRare #yColorless card at the start of the run.
BALATRO-FLUSHED.title: Flushed
BALATRO-FLUSHED.description: If you have not played any #yPowers during your turn, gain an extra [E][E] next turn.
BALATRO-RETROGRADE.title: Retrograde
BALATRO-RETROGRADE.flavor: Quick check if everything is ready.
BALATRO-RETROGRADE.description: #yUpgrade half of your deck at start of combat.
BALATRO-R_O_I.title: ROI
BALATRO-R_O_I.flavor: Lift the shop to new heights.
BALATRO-R_O_I.description: Cards in shops are #yUpgraded. #yPotions in the shops are at least #yUncommon. Guarantee one #yRare card in the shop.
BALATRO-BIG_HANDS.title: Big Hands
BALATRO-BIG_HANDS.flavor: Believe in the hands of fate.
BALATRO-BIG_HANDS.description: Draw #b2 additional cards each turn. On Card Reward screens, you have #b1 less card to choose from.
BALATRO-HIGH_STAKES.title: High Stakes
BALATRO-HIGH_STAKES.description: After selecting a Boss relic, gain another random Boss relic.
BALATRO-RULE_BENDER.title: Rule Bender
BALATRO-RULE_BENDER.description: Whenever an #yAttack is played, gain half of the damage as #yBlock. #bALL enemies have double their health.
BALATRO-SHATTERED.title: Shattered
BALATRO-SHATTERED.description: Start with a random deck of #b20 cards.
BALATRO-OVERSTOCK_PLUS.title: Overstock Plus
BALATRO-OVERSTOCK_PLUS.description: Future shops have three additional relics.
BALATRO-LIQUIDATION.title: Liquidation
BALATRO-GLOW_UP.title: Glow Up
BALATRO-GLOW_UP.description: Add a random #yLegendary card to your deck.
BALATRO-REROLL_GLUT.title: Reroll Glut
BALATRO-REROLL_GLUT.description: Click to reroll the cards in the shop, costs #b50 #yGold per roll.
BALATRO-OMEN_GLOBE.title: Omen Globe
BALATRO-OMEN_GLOBE.description: Whenever you use a potion in combat, get a random #yColorless card.
BALATRO-OBSERVATORY.title: Observatory
BALATRO-NACHO_TONG.title: Nacho Tong
BALATRO-NACHO_TONG.description: Gain [E] at the start of each turn.
BALATRO-RECYCLOMANCY.title: Recyclomancy
BALATRO-RECYCLOMANCY.description: Whenever you manually discard #b7 cards, gain #b1 #yStrength.
BALATRO-TAROT_TYCOON.title: Tarot Tycoon
BALATRO-TAROT_TYCOON.description: Whenever you obtain a potion, gain #b1 maximum Health.
BALATRO-PLANET_TYCOON.title: Planet Tycoon
BALATRO-PLANET_TYCOON.description: Whenever you add a #yCommon card to your deck, it is #yUpgraded.
BALATRO-MONEY_TREE.title: Money Tree
BALATRO-MONEY_TREE.flavor: You believed them when they said money doesn't grow on trees?
BALATRO-MONEY_TREE.description: Increase the maximum combat Gold to #b400.
BALATRO-ANTIMATTER.title: Antimatter
BALATRO-ANTIMATTER.flavor: Maybe this one looks better than that one.
BALATRO-ANTIMATTER.description: Future card rewards have #b1 additional card to choose from.
BALATRO-ILLUSION.title: Illusion
BALATRO-ILLUSION.description: Choose and add a #yCommon, #yUncommon and #yRare card to your deck.
BALATRO-PETROGLYPH.title: Petroglyph
BALATRO-PETROGLYPH.description: Reduce the max health of all enemies by #b10%.
BALATRO-RETCON.title: Retcon
BALATRO-RETCON.description: Click to reroll a Blind, costs #b50 #yGold per roll. (Only usable on first turn before playing a card)
BALATRO-PALETTE.title: Palette
BALATRO-PALETTE.description: At the start of your turn, draw #b1 additional card.
